_comment: Module stories generated on the server after every successful deploy (.github/workflows/generate-lesson-story.yml). Each entry asks for the story of one module: module_index (default 1, the first module by number) of the course its query matches, or the module module_id, in the given languages. An entry that matches nothing on a server is skipped there; a cached, fresh module story is reused at no cost, so entries can stay. The module_id entry is the staging test module. See load_requests in generate_lesson_stories.py for the fields.
